shots.prompt: A wide commercial lifestyle photograph of an outdoor picnic still life in front of a distant open-air concert at dusk. In the foreground, unlabeled clear plastic water bottles, an unlabeled fruit-drink stand-up pouch with orange fruit printed on the pack, an unlabeled dark beverage can, and two hamburgers sit on a red picnic blanket. Behind them a metal stage truss, LED screens, and a seated crowd recede into a warm sunset sky of peach and gold. Photorealistic catalog-hero lighting, sharp product detail in front, softly glowing sky behind. Blank packaging with no lettering, no logos, no watermarks, no captions.
